clause.title: Platform-confirmed arrival and waiting
clause.rule: Where trip_record.platform_policy.arrival_marker is GPS_AUTO and trip_record.events carries the platform's own arrival event stating its geofence test (for example "Driver GPS within 10m of pickup point. Speed 0 km/h. Auto-arrival confirmed"), together with wait_timer_started and wait_timer_expired events, those events are PLATFORM_TELEMETRY records of the platform's full-resolution measurement. They are a carrier independent of the exported gps_trace for POL-NS-01 limbs (b) and (c) and for POL-GEN-02(2): arrival is established at the arrival event's time, and the free waiting period is established as served when wait_timer_expired precedes the termination, unless an admissible fix in the exported trace affirmatively places the driver outside the arrival radius, or moving at 15 km/h or more, during the window (POL-NS-05). A sparse or accuracy-less export trace does not impair these events; it is weighed only for contradiction. A driver-pressed arrival marker (BUTTON) is not covered by this clause. This clause licenses no ruling value.
clause.notes: Added because an exported gps_trace can be sparse, with fixes minutes apart, and report no horizontal accuracy, so the consecutive-fix test of POL-NS-02 cannot be run on it even when the platform itself confirmed the arrival from its own full-resolution stream. The platform's arrival and wait-timer events are its own measurement, not a copy of the export; treating them as the same carrier would send every such case to review although nothing in the record contradicts the platform. The clause covers only platform-confirmed (GPS_AUTO) arrival; a driver-pressed marker remains subject to POL-NS-02 and POL-NS-05.

drafted_by: Zhou Hanwei (owner), 2026-10-09, for confirmation by Ji Guofang (policy owner)
source: The version-3 run of the organisers' sample (case 901, converted from DISP-002) on 2026-10-09 escalated unanimously: the exported trace held four fixes in the waiting window, minutes apart and with no accuracy field, so POL-NS-02 could not run, and the judge treated the platform's auto-arrival event as the same carrier as the trace. The platform's events record auto-arrival within 10 m at speed 0 and an expired free-wait timer before the fee.
